414:t_100:1.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't want to kill the Lieutenant Colonel!」

414:t_100:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. The enemy unit's maneuverability surpasses this unit's.」

414:t_100:3.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「The strong and the weak support one another through reason. That is what it means to be human. Isn't it, $$レド$$?」

414:t_100:4.en:
$$レド$$
「Strong or weak doesn't matter...! Everyone is alive... Everyone is human!!」

414:t_101:0.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I am $$ラケージ$$, called the Great Pirate... If you thought I'd stay docile forever, you'll get more than a burn from me.」

414:t_101:1.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Take a good taste of the power of this wave-riding lobster, refitted with the materials I got from those people!」

414:t_102:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Your resistance is meaningless.」

414:t_102:1.en:
$$レド$$
「Even so, I have a reason I can't back down!」

414:t_102:2.en:
$$レド$$
「If I let you through, $$ガルガンティア$$... $$エイミー$$ and $$ベベル$$ will be put in danger! I will stop that at all costs!!」

414:t_103:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$. You are judged unfit as a soldier. Therefore, you will be erased.」

414:t_103:1.en:
$$レド$$
「Your very existence is the distortion of the $$人類銀河同盟$$ itself!」

414:t_103:2.en:
$$レド$$
「No matter what you say, I will live! I will live and fight by my own will!」

414:t_103:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit's mission is to support Ensign $$レド$$'s fight.」

414:t_103:4.en:
$$レド$$
「Let's do this, $$チェインバー#pilot$$! Nothing binds us anymore!!」

414:t_104:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ブレラ$$...! This time I'll stop you for sure!」

414:t_104:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「You can't. I am a completed soldier. Your combat skills won't work on me.」

414:t_104:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Don't decide that on your own! My wings will tear through the fog of this sea!」

414:t_104:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「For $$ランカ$$, who believes in me and believes you'll come back!!」

414:t_105:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Neither machines nor humans can become something more than human!」

414:t_105:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll prove it! By beating you, as a mere human!」

414:t_106:0.en:
$n
「Sure, giving up your own judgment and living by following someone else must be easy...」

414:t_106:1.en:
$n
「But you can't call that living! No matter how much I suffer, I decide my own way of life myself!」

414:t_107:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(Sorry, $$ランカ$$... I meant to protect you, but I made you worry again...)

414:t_107:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
(But I swear... I will never again let you shed tears of sadness...!)
